title: devgon
subtitle: Code-first CMS - and the engine behind this site
description: A universal content layer: build the UI freely in Next.js, then expose any section to admin editing - no backend changes, no schema migrations. One extensible Content entity backs every section, behind a GraphQL API. Full production DevOps owned solo.

title: carsold.pl
subtitle: Car marketplace platform, built solo from scratch
description: Full car listing platform built solo - Spring Boot backend, React frontend, PostgreSQL schema, cloud services and deployment. Custom auth (Google OAuth2, JWT in HttpOnly cookies), real-time chat over WebSocket, admin panel with RBAC, automated content moderation via Google Cloud.

title: Fencing product configurator
subtitle: Built end-to-end at Budmat, used daily in sales
description: Built end-to-end - data model, API, calculation logic, UI and deployment - fully parametrized for offer and production capacity. Used daily by 30+ sales representatives, feeding straight into the ordering pipeline. Later extended with 3D visualization.

title: PV quoting & BOM tools
subtitle: Hours of quote preparation cut down to minutes
description: A suite of quoting and bill-of-materials tools for photovoltaic structures - roof-mount, tracker and carport - with deep product parametrization and calculation algorithms. Adopted across a 20-person engineering and sales division and consumed directly by production.

title: PV field-inspection app
subtitle: Smart inspections for photovoltaic farms
description: A mobile application for field inspections - GPS route tracking, photo capture, defect logging and automated report generation. I contributed alongside requirements, UI and UX, feature design, testing and acceptance criteria.
